paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anam pumpi ua Jordan lui agalkah siang nung un, TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah,
heading: Theihgigena Suangte Phuh Ahi
english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

paite: "Mipite lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel telkhia inla,
english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

paite: akiang uah, Jordan lui lai, siampute dinna laitak a suangte sawm-le-nih la unla, pophei unla, giahphual, tuzan a na giahna ding uah koih un, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

paite: Huchi in Joshua in Israel suante lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel atelkhiakte asam a;
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "TOUPA na Pathian uh bawm ma ah Jordan lui lai ah galkah unla, Israel suante anam zah zel in, michih in suang khat chiat pua hen.
english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

paite: Hiaite na lak uah chiamtehna ahong hi ding a, tunung chiang in na tate un, hiai suangte bang na chihna uh ahia? chỉ a ahon dot chiang un,
english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

paite: Nou akiang uah, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a Jordan tuite ahong kan tak ziak in ahi. Jordan akan lai un, Jordan tuite ahong kitat a ahi. Hiai suangte Israel suante'n tangtawn a atheihgigena ding uh ahi, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

paite: Israel suante'n Joshua thupiak bang in ahih ua, Israel suante'n anam zah zel in, Jordan lui lai a suang sawm-le-nih ala ua; agiahphual uah, apophei ua, huai ah akoih uhi.
english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

paite: Thukhun bawm zawng siampute dinna laitak, Jordan lui lai ah Joshua in huai suang sawm-le-nihte aphut a; huaite tuni tan in a-om lai uhi.
english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

paite: Mosi in Joshua thu ana piak tengteng bang a TOUPA'N mipite kiang a hih dia Joshua thu apiak ahihzoh vek mateng uh siampu bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai ah adingh nilouh uhi. Mipite akinoh ua, agalkahta uhi.
english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng agalkah siang vek nung un, TOUPA bawm leh siampute leng mipi mitmuh in agalkahta uhi.
heading: Jordan Lui Kante Kivolhdan
english: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in akiang ua ana gen khitsa bang in, Israel suante ma ah kigalthuam in agalkah uhi.
english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.

paite: Galvan a kivan dimdiam mi singli vel galdou ding in Jeriko phaizang ah TOUPA ma ah agalkah uhi.
english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

paite: Huai ni in TOUPA'N Israel tengteng mitmuh in Joshua atawisang a; Mosi alauh mah bang un adamsung teng in amah alau uhi.
english: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah thu agen a:
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

paite: "Siampute, thu theihpihna bawm zawngte Jordan lui a pan hong pawt ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

paite: Joshua in siampute, "Jordan lui a pan hong pawtta un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai a pan ahong pawt ua, siampute khete'n leihul asiktak in, Jordan tuite aluan ngeina bang un ahong luang nawn ua, ama a mah bang in akuang ah aluanglet nawn hi.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

paite: Mipite akha khatna, ani sawm ni in Jordan lui a pan apawt ua, Jeriko suahlam pang Gilgal ah giahphual asatta uhi.
heading: Gilgal A Giahphual Bawlna
english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

paite: Jordan lui a pan suang sawm-le-nih apuakkhiak uh, Joshua in Gilgal ah aphut hi.
english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah, "Tunung chiang a na suante un apate uh kiang a, hiai suangte bang chihna ahia? chi a hon dot chiang un,
english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

paite: Israelte'n Jordan lui leihul ah agalkah ua ahi, chi in na suante uh na theisak ding uhi.'
english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un nidanglai a Tuipi San i galkah masiah ua, i ma ua ana kangtatsak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan tuite na galkah masiah uh na ma uah akangtatsak a ahi.
english: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

paite: Lei a nam chiteng in TOUPA khut ana hat ngei, chih atheih ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh tangtawn a alauhtheihna ding un," chi in agen hi.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”
